theorems.statement: If A is a division algebra and a,b in A are nonzero, then ab is nonzero. Equivalently, an exact witness a!=0, b!=0, ab=0 certifies that A is not a division algebra.
For nonzero x in an eight-dimensional real positive-definite composition algebra, L_x/sqrt(N(x)) is in SO(8).
For finite r:X->S with fiber sizes m_s, sum_s (m_s)_k equals the number of ordered k-tuples of pairwise distinct elements of X having equal r-image.
theorems.novelty_status: bridge novelty unassessed; identity is elementary

theorems.statement: For nonzero real division octonions x,y, D(x,y)=U_x U_y U_xy^{-1} lies in SO(8), fixes the normalized xy direction, and equals I exactly when [x,y,z]=0 for every z.
theorems.novelty_status: bridge novelty unassessed; operator packaging may be new

theorems.statement: For a finite G-set X and G-invariant r:X->S, quotient occupancies are given fiberwise by Burnside averages and their falling-factorial sums count ordered distinct G-orbits with common r-image.
theorems.novelty_status: bridge novelty unassessed; arithmetic certificate application may be new
